open_points.subject: add_trial_case and execute_trial_case empty input file-list representation
open_points.text: A trial case therefore names exactly the contract's input ports
open_points.other_text: an input or an expected output of a file list with no files names no StoredValuesRef
open_points.question: Must an empty input file list name its port with a StoredValuesRef, or is the absence of such a ref the representation of that named port?

open_points.subject: add_trial_case and execute_trial_case empty expected-output file-list representation
open_points.text: expected_outputs is either absent or names exactly every output port: a partial expected_outputs, and an empty object, is given and fails presence at its first missing port; only absence means no expected outputs.
open_points.other_text: When the case has expected outputs, they MUST be compared per output port of the contract version, never per port the refs happen to name: an output port that no expected StoredValuesRef names is an expected file list with no files.
open_points.question: Must every expected output port be named by a StoredValuesRef, with an unnamed port failing presence, or must an unnamed output port be interpreted as an expected empty file list?
